question: What are Stellar Limits Proposals SLP-0004 and SLP-0006, and which one was final versus still draft as of July 11, 2026?

golden.answer: As of July 11, 2026, SLP-0004 was Final. It raised Soroban limits including per-transaction instructions from 100 million to 400 million, write entries from 50 to 200, and footprint size from 100 to 200 entries; it also proposed roughly fourfold reductions for most non-refundable resource fees. SLP-0006 was still Draft. It proposes moving the existing overlay-layer block on three accounts associated with the February 22 YieldBlox V2 exploit into network configuration using CAP-0077. SLPs are Stellar Limits Proposals, not CAPs or SEPs. The Draft label described the document, not the network: from Mainnet ledger 63073409 (2026-06-17 17:00 UTC) onward, the `frozen_ledger_keys` network setting has held these three account keys (observed 2026-11-02). The repository marked SLP-0006 Final on 2026-10-22.
keyFacts: Reports SLP status as of July 11, 2026: SLP-0004 Final, SLP-0006 Draft.
Lists SLP-0004 per-tx instructions 100M→400M, write entries 50→200, footprint 100→200.
Reports roughly fourfold cuts to most SLP-0004 non-refundable fees.
Describes SLP-0006's proposed CAP-0077 network configuration.
Names 3 already overlay-blocked YieldBlox exploit accounts.
avoid: Do NOT call either proposal a SEP or CAP.
Do NOT say SLP-0006 was Final on July 11, 2026, or infer from its Draft label that the freeze was not applied.
golden.notes:
SLP-0006 is status-sensitive. Preserve the as-of date and accept a newer sourced status rather than pinning Draft forever.
CORRECTION 2026-11-02: SLP-0006 stayed Draft until 2026-10-22, but Mainnet frozen_ledger_keys has held its three keys since ledger 63073409 (2026-06-17). Grade document status and network application separately; accept the current Final status if the answer keeps the July 11 Draft status.
